fusions.name: Venom Fetch
fusions.desc: Spits venom that deals 8 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Fatal Dose
fusions.desc: Releases a lethal cloud that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and makes them [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Shed Coat
fusions.desc: Removes every condition from you, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Venom Rights
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 10% poison resistance for as long as you carry it.
